text:
incident-bot: ALERT: pager flood detected — 240 `inference_error` alerts in the last 5m, PagerDuty escalations triggered (policy: infra-high). Correlation: many have fingerprint `model-oom-v2` and region `us-west-2`. Auto-mitigations: none applied.

sara: oncall here, I see the spikes. opening the incident thread. can someone check if customers are impacted? :eyes: 

mike: i can take a look at PD noise. first thought: temporary suppression/dedupe on PD for that fingerprint/alertname to avoid paging spam while we investigate.

jin: logs show backend retries but no increased 5xx to customers so far — mostly internal OOMs that self-retry. latency to clients is up ~150-300ms on avg for a subset of requests. i'll keep watching.

sara: ok, agreement: reduce immediate noise. mike — propose a 30m suppression rule scoped to `alertname=inference_error` and `fingerprint=model-oom-v2`. also add a short dashboard for quick triage.

mike: plan: create a PD suppression (non-ack silence) + change alertmanager grouping temporarily. doing the PD mute now. posting pd mute id when done.

alex: for longer-term, grouping by `model` + `region` and reducing `group_interval` spam helps. suggested Alertmanager route patch:
```yaml
route:
  receiver: 'pagerduty-oncall'
  group_by: ['alertname', 'fingerprint', 'region']
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 10m
  repeat_interval: 4h
```
This groups bursts and avoids paging on every instance.

mike: PD suppression applied: `/pd mute --integration=redwood --scope="alertname:inference_error, fingerprint:model-oom-v2" --duration=30m` — suppression id `pd-suppress-4821`. will monitor. :white_check_mark:

tasha: i'll spin up a tiny dashboard in grafana: - count(alerts by fingerprint) - 95p latency by region - OOM rate by model. will share link when ready.

jin: customer impact update: no critical customer errors reported in the last 10m. however, a downstream retries pile might cause transient increased cost. adding `alerts:severity=warning` for now.

sara: good. we should also create a follow-up ticket to make these changes permanent and add tests so a similar spike doesn't cause PD overload. items:
- create INF-2345: "Alert grouping + rate-limit baseline for inference OOMs"
- add automated fingerprinting to reduce noise (alex)
- add runbook entry for temporary PD suppression (mike)
- dashboard PR (tasha)

alex: i can take INF-2345 and prototype a grouping algorithm that uses `model+region+failure-type`. will link RFC.

mike: handoff — i'm the next oncall for the next 4 hours.  monitoring alerts and PD suppression id noted. if anyone sees customer-facing 5xx, escalate immediately.

incident-bot: action logged: PD suppression `pd-suppress-4821` created by mike at 1876543400. ticket INF-2345 created by sara.

sara:  handoff comment: leaving this with mike; follow-ups assigned. will check back in 1h. thanks team. :pray:

mike: thanks — i'll watch and update every 15m. if suppression expires and alerts spike again we can extend to 2h or revert to grouping config change.

tasha: dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/alerts/inference-ooms (wip) — PR in a minute.

jin: monitoring note: enable KV cache metrics to correlate with OOMs in case it's related to sequence lengths. added to INF-2345.

sara: closing this temporary thread for now — plan is: 30m suppression in place, dashboard + ticket created, long-term grouping/rate-limit RFC assigned. handoff complete.

mike: confirmed last check at 1876545470 — suppression still active, alerts reduced to background levels. ending live mitigation.
